title: Melt the self into praise
summary: Praise is not self-improvement; it is metal returning to metal, the separate self taking on the deep crimson color of Truth.
takeaway: Stay in praise until the separate self begins to take Truth's color.
lifeApplication: When comparison makes you hard-edged, sing or recite one line slowly enough for the need to stand apart to loosen.

source.shortMeaning: In praise, the separate self merges like metal with metal and is dyed in the deep color of Truth.
source.lifeApplication: When comparison hardens you, stay with praise until separateness begins to soften into the Lord's color.

evidence.coreClaim: Praise absorbs the self into the Praiseworthy Lord and dyes the heart in Truth's deep color.
evidence.turn: Let praise do more than steady the mood; let it melt the separate self that comparison keeps polishing.
evidence.practicalImplication: When comparison makes you hard-edged, sing or recite one line slowly enough for the need to stand apart to loosen.
